Bangladesh Resumes Indian Wheat Purchases Amid Supply Disruptions

Bangladesh has resumed purchasing wheat from India, a move prompted by disruptions in Black Sea supplies. This resumption of trade comes as high rice prices in Bangladesh are reportedly leading consumers to opt for roti (flatbread), increasing demand for wheat. The Hindu BusinessLine reported on the resumption of purchases due to global supply chain issues, while India Today highlighted the domestic economic pressure in Bangladesh driving the demand for Indian wheat.
